Confirmed by `git checkout origin/main && python -m pytest -m legacy_excel tests/test_persistence.py` -> same ImportError. Out of scope for Phase 51D-1.

recommended_next_phase: Phase 51D-2 — /validate route vertical extraction into app/services/validation_service.py. Use the same behavior-first approach as 51B and 51C-2: (1) Create validation_service.py with the proposed API (ValidateRouteOutcome / ValidateRouteDeps / execute_validate_route). (2) Slim /validate route in main_web.py. (3) Decide on the runtime-snapshot-resolved-but-unused call: preserve for parity (recommended) OR drop for cleanup (alternative, must be explicitly documented in 51D-2 PR). (4) Pin the new contract with a Phase 51D-2 test suite mirroring test_phase51c2_compare_route_vertical_extraction.py. (5) Update Phase 51A / 51B / 51C-1 / 51C-2 / 51D-1 tests for the new contract (same relaxations as 51B and 51C-2).
